title: Notice Given to the Snowsports School Before a Change of Date
content:
The more warning the Snowsports School is given, the less a change of date costs. The warning is counted in calendar days between the handling date and the date the first session is due to run, the handling date counting as day zero.

Where the first session is seven or more days off, the long notice fee is charged, and it stands at 20.00 USD. Where the first session is between three and six days off, the mid notice fee is charged, and it stands at 35.00 USD. Where the first session is fewer than three days off, the product's move fee is charged.

## The move fees the last band reads

| Product | Move fee (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 25.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 25.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 25.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 95.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 45.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 75.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 250.00 |

## The bands on both sides of each boundary

| Calendar days between the handling date and the first session | Fee charged |
| --- | --- |
| 7 or more | 20.00 USD |
| exactly 7 | 20.00 USD |
| 6 | 35.00 USD |
| exactly 3 | 35.00 USD |
| 2 | the product's move fee |
| none, the session falling on the handling date | the product's move fee |

## A reading on hypothetical records

Take a booking of the Private Instruction Full Day, whose move fee is 75.00 USD, and a handling date of the fifth of a month. A first session due on the twelfth is 7 days off, so the fee charged is 20.00 USD. A first session due on the eleventh is 6 days off, so it is 35.00 USD. A first session due on the seventh is 2 days off, so the product's move fee of 75.00 USD is charged.
